svg.aria-label: Muninn. Notes you gave your assistant travel from you towards it through a ring, the memory. Monday's note, prices in dollars, was replaced on Thursday by a change of plan to euros: it turns down inside the ring, is crossed out and put away, and only the notes that still hold reach the assistant. In the project's tests a replaced decision slipped back into the work 0 times out of 54.
svg.text: Your assistant remembers your decisions, and lets go of the ones you changed.
